description: Offline "what-if": given a hypothetical dependency context and a config, report which `packageRules` match (in order), which matcher decided each, and what each matched rule contributes. Answers "why didn't my rule match?". Rules are evaluated with Renovate's REAL matchers in a worker thread (faithful), classified against the fields you actually supplied — a matcher that needs a field you didn't pass is reported as `unevaluatable`, never silently treated as a non-match. Matchers needing post-lookup data (matchUpdateTypes, matchCurrentVersion, matchNewValue, matchCurrentAge) or the merge-confidence API (matchConfidence) are unevaluatable offline; matchJsonata is advisory. Pass either `repoPath` (reads + expands the repo's config) or `configContent` (an inline config); `externalPresets`/`endpoint`/`platform` opt into external preset expansion so `extends`-provided rules are included (same semantics as resolve_config). Deprecated matcher keys (matchPackagePatterns, …) are warned about — run migrate_config first. Also renders the effective branchName / commitMessage / prTitle (and groupName) for the synthetic dependency under `rendered` — a preview built from the fields you supplied, which lists the post-lookup template variables it could not fill. Run dry_run for full-fidelity confirmation.

configContent.description: Inline config object whose packageRules to test — use instead of repoPath.

currentValue.description: Current version constraint from the file, e.g. ^1.2.0 (matchCurrentValue; static).

currentVersion.description: Resolved current version, e.g. 1.2.3 (matchCurrentVersion; normally known only after a datasource lookup).

currentVersionTimestamp.description: Release timestamp of the current version (matchCurrentAge; post-lookup).

endpoint.description: API base URL that `local>` presets are fetched from (with `platform`) — same semantics as resolve_config.

externalPresets.description: When true, fetch external presets (github>, gitlab>, gitea>, forgejo>) over HTTPS so their packageRules are included — same credentials/behaviour as resolve_config. Default false.

isBreaking.description: Whether the update is breaking per its versioning (matchIsBreaking; post-lookup).

isBump.description: Whether this is a range bump (matchUpdateTypes; post-lookup).

lockedVersion.description: Locked version from a lockfile (matchCurrentVersion; post-lookup).

mergeConfidenceLevel.description: Merge-confidence level (matchConfidence; needs the merge-confidence API — unevaluatable offline).

newVersion.description: Resolved new version, e.g. 5.0.0 (templates only: fills newMajor/newMinor/newPatch in the rendered names; defaults to newValue when that is a single version).

platform.description: The platform `local>` presets live on — same semantics as resolve_config (routes only; never moves a token).

repoPath.description: Absolute path to the repository root. The tool locates and expands the repo's renovate config automatically.

name: test_package_rules
title: Test which packageRules match a dependency
